Dress, kosulja. Long, slightly flared dress with bell sleeves, made in natural colored cotton or linen. Plain except for thin line of black & red embroidery around the simple collar and neck opening. Heavy band of black and white solid embroidery in geometeric patterns around wrists, with black fringe; similar embroidery & fringe around hem, with the addition of a band of blue, red, green & black squares. Part of woman's costume 1981.35.31-33.

Long waistcoat, jelek; worn over dress (1981.35.31). Orange cotton lined with natural coloured cotton and quilted; with a layer of maroon wool around shoulder and cap sleeves. There is a band of green wool around neck opening, with blue wool and gold braid alongside as decoration. The hem is decorated with braids of red silk, green & blue wool, and gold braid all sewn through several thicknesses. Part of woman's costume 1981.35.31-33.

Long waistcoat, jelek. Blue patterned sleeveless cotton coat is sewn in panels to make it flared. The bodice is covered with black cotton and quilted; black piping round edges. There is black braid down the seams, across the back and in a thick band around the hem. Worn over dress and second waistcoat as part of woman's costume 1981.35.31-33.
